name: Synthwave
tagline: Neon sunsets on an endless grid.
what_it_means: Synthwave (outrun / retrowave) is a love letter to 1980s sci-fi and arcade culture: a striped neon sunset over a glowing perspective grid, chrome type, magenta and cyan glows and dark purple skies. It feels cinematic, nostalgic and energetic.
signature_moves: Striped gradient sun on the horizon
best_for: Music, gaming, events, nightlife, retro-themed launches
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a hero for [GAME / MUSIC EVENT] in Synthwave (outrun) style. Night sky gradient from deep purple (#0D0221) to magenta at the horizon with tiny stars. A big sunset sun with a yellow-to-pink gradient (#F9C80E to #FF2A6D) cut by horizontal stripes on its lower half. Below the horizon, a glowing magenta perspective grid floor (CSS transform: perspective + rotateX) that scrolls toward the viewer. Headline in Monoton / Orbitron with neon cyan (#05D9E8) glow and a chrome italic subtitle. Neon-outline buttons. Add subtle scanlines.
